description: Start review here. Groups a run's mappings by the URL rewrite they apply (from → to, e.g. /product/{slug}/ → /products/{slug}), groups with the most undecided rows first. kind is moved, kept_tail, same_path, unchanged (no redirect needed) or unmatched; renamed counts rows whose last segment also changed. Each group has counts by state, the confidence range of its undecided proposals and up to three examples, lowest confidence first. Show the person each group as a rule with its examples and let them decide per group (resolve_group), opening a group with list_matches group_id when they want to see every row. A group is a way to read proposals, not a decision. Keep data.selection_revision for resolve_group.

filter.description: Group only rows in this state.

offset.description: Groups to skip; use data.next_offset until it is null.
